messages:
oliver_sales: FYI HarborAnalytics POC wants to close today. They sent a redlined MSA + PO template. Must-haves: PO on signed orderform, SCCs, tenant key isolation attestation, and a hard 30-day erase requirement. Can legal/procurement triage?

rebecca_legal: Upload their redline pls. 30-day erase across all copies is a tough ask. We usually propose 30 days for customer-visible data, 90 days for backups. Also need to scan for any expanded liability or indemnity edits.

oliver_sales: Uploaded: Harbor_MSA_Redline_0426.pdf. They swapped our DPA for their SCC appendix and added a clause requiring KMS/HSM attestation with tenant HSM as "preferred". Payment term in their PO is net60 and PO must be present on signed doc.

mike_procure: We can add PO field + billing block + tax ID. Finance default is net30; net60 needs approval. Provisional PO (PO to be added post-signature) is acceptable to some customers but not all. Do they allow provisional?

harbor_poc: (via oliver_sales) Their AP requires PO on signed form; provisional PO not allowed. Net60 is standard for them. They also asked for a list of subprocessors inline on the orderform for procurement records.

tara_sre: KMS attestation: we can provide factual language about logical key separation and KMS provider. We do not offer tenant-scoped HSMs on hosted. If they require tenant HSM we have to discuss Private deployment + pricing. We can share SOC2 redacted and subprocessor schedule link.

rebecca_legal: Draft counterpoints: 1) Deletion: 30 days for customer-facing data, 90 days for backups/archives. 2) Subprocessors: keep as a schedule link with 30 days' notice for changes (avoid listing inline). 3) KMS attestation factual-only, no warranty. 4) SCCs OK if materially equivalent; attach and accept subject to carveouts. I'll prepare a DPA redline and short attestation.

oliver_sales: Please paste the attestation text here so I can forward to Harbor procurement. Also need a quick orderform template with PO field.

rebecca_legal: Attestation (pasteable): ```
KMS / Key Management Attestation: Redwood Inference confirms that within its hosted service, customer encryption keys are logically isolated per customer and are managed using industry-standard KMS controls. Redwood does not retain customer keys in plaintext and employs standard key rotation and access controls. This attestation is informational and does not create additional contractual liability under the MSA.
```

mike_procure: I'll draft the orderform with a PO number field, invoice-to/remit-to, and a line referencing the subprocessor schedule URL. Set payment terms to net30 with a finance escalation note for net60.

harbor_poc: They replied: net60 is mandatory for AP and they will not accept provisional PO. If no tenant HSM, they asked for a signed statement that keys are tenant-isolated and for the SOC2 report. They will initial redlines if we accept the 30/90 split and the attestation.

rebecca_legal: Ok. We'll accept the 30/90 split and provide the attestation language, but explicitly state attestation is informational and does not expand liability. Ask them to initial retained redlines to speed closure.

finance-bot: Finance note: net60 can be approved for deals with expected ARR > $125k; please confirm forecast to route. Otherwise default net30.

oliver_sales: Forecasted ARR if converted ~180k. Escalating for net60 approval now. Tagging @finance.

mike_procure: Escalation in flight. Meanwhile I'm uploading the orderform to DocuSign with PO field and subprocessor reference.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: "Redwood  HarborAnalytics POC Orderform + MSA" (env id: h1v2a3). Recipients: harbor_signer, oliver_sales, rebecca_legal (cc).

rebecca_legal: One last ask  request Harbor to initial any MSA redlines they intend to keep. That reduces back-and-forth and prevents silent edits.

harbor_poc: They viewed the packet and initialled the DPA redline. Confirmed acceptance of 30/90 deletion split and requested SOC2 redacted + subprocessor schedule link. PO number will be placed on form before signing (their AP needs PO on document).

mike_procure: FYI I'm including an explicit "PO number required" field that must be filled by the signer. Finance approved net60 based on forecast; payment terms set net60.

esign-bot: Envelope viewed by harbor_signer at 2177777818.

harbor_poc: They asked a clarifying q: if they later require tenant-specific HSMs, can we present a migration/quote path?

tara_sre: Yes  we can propose Private deployment with tenant HSM; that'll be a separate scope and pricing conversation but we can include an appendix referencing upgrade path.

esign-bot: Envelope completed at 2177777830. Signed MSA, DPA, and orderform (with PO) uploaded to deals/HarborAnalytics/2026/attachments.

oliver_sales: Great  attaching signed docs to CRM and routing to finance for invoice processing. Thanks everyone for the rapid turnaround. :tada:
